fusions.name: Marking Snap
fusions.desc: Snaps at an enemy up to 3.5 tiles away, which deals 4 damage, rising to 1.3 times that at full reach. Each hit has a 30% chance to leave the target [Marked] for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Run to Ground
fusions.desc: A strike with your weapon that deals 22 damage and leaves the target [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 5 seconds. It only lands on a target at or below 30% health.

fusions.name: Long Patient Watch
fusions.desc: For 25 seconds, you settle into a long watch and your attacks and spells reach 43% further.

fusions.name: Slow Pursuit
fusions.desc: Against enemies below 50% health, your damage rises by 12%. Your armour rises by 5% at all times.
